entries.blocker: Official vw_coco2014_96.tar.gz is not obtainable (HTTP 403, no published checksum); the measured 0.858 on the local images is provisional. COCO-derived labels: person if a person annotation covers at least 2.5 percent of the image, 96x96 antialiased resize, train2014+val2014 combined (Silicon Labs script); COCO images keep their Flickr terms.
MUSAN (about 11 GB) not approved for download; deferred by decision.; Quality target: at most 8 false positives and at most 8 false negatives (rules text at the pinned commit and the public page).
